meta.name: tool-calling-tutor
meta.description: Use when a tool-calling agent does not call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops without stopping, or needs a function schema. Guides a four-branch diagnosis and five-step schema repair. Do not use for framework-specific, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 修复智能体工具调用失灵与参数报错
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的AI智能体总是不调用工具或传错参数,需要定位根因
copy.tagline_en: Fix AI tool-calling failures and wrong arguments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're debugging an AI agent that fails to call tools or passes wrong arguments

howto.what: 装上后,当模型不调用工具、参数错误、循环不停或需要设计函数 schema 时,Claude 会先询问四种症状中的哪一种,再按对应分支给出诊断和修复建议;不直接替你写代码。
howto.when: 当你提到工具调用问题,例如「LLM 不呼叫我的 tool」「schema 哪里写坏了」「args 不对」等时触发。

say.text: 为什么我的 LLM 就是不调用我定义的 tool?
say.note: Claude 会先让你选症状,再对照描述与工具边界排查。

say.text: 帮我设计一个函数 schema,用来转换温度单位。
我的 ReAct loop 一直跑不停,该怎么办?

howto.what_en: When the model won't call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops forever, or needs a function schema, Claude first asks which of four symptoms applies, then walks through the matching diagnostic and fix; it doesn't write code for you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention tool-calling problems, e.g. "LLM won't call my tool", "schema is broken", "args are wrong", etc.

say_en.text: Why won't my LLM ever call the tool I defined?
say_en.note: Claude triages symptoms first, then checks description and tool boundaries.

say_en.text: Help me design a function schema for temperature conversion.
say_en.note: Claude walks you through the 5-step design.

say_en.text: My ReAct loop never stops. What should I do?
say_en.note: Claude walks you through control-flow causes.
